testcase.name: test_push_cannot_run_the_two_paid_observer_jobs

failure.message:
AssertionError: '
 push:' unexpectedly found in 'name: A1 YouTube Diversity Scout V1

on:
 push:
 branches: ['codex/issue1414-preauto-contract-20261008']
 paths: ['tests/test_issue1414_preauto_contract_v1.py']
 pull_request:
 branches: [master]
 paths:
 - 'backend/research/architecture_factory/a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1.py'
 - 'backend/research/architecture_factory/a1_gemini_youtube_roi_policy_v1.json'
 - 'tests/test_issue1414_preauto_contract_v1.py'
 - 'tests/test_a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1.py'
 - '.github/workflows/a1-youtube-diversity-scout-v1.yml'
 workflow_dispatch:
 inputs:
 blocker:
 description: 'JSON: blocker/lane/candidate/failure_signature/required_sources/development_evidence_ref/implementation_sha256/buckets'
 required: true
 type: string
 existing_receipt:
 description: 'Committed previous scoped receipt path for cache/resume; ingest prior artifact through PR before a repeat run'
 required: true
 default: 'backend/research/architecture_factory/a1_youtube_diversity_latest.json'
 type: string

permissions:
 contents: read

concurrency:
 group: a1-youtube-diversity-scout-v1
 cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
 verify:
 if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/issue1414-preauto-contract-20261008')
 runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 timeout-minutes: 10
 steps:
 - uses: actions/checkout@v4
 with:
 persist-credentials: false
 - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
 with:
 python-version: '3.12'
 - name: Compile and deterministic self-test
 run: |
 set -euo pipefail
 python -m py_compile backend/research/architecture_factory/a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1.py
 python -m backend.research.architecture_factory.a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1 --self-test
 - name: Generated-price and cached-source integration fixtures (no economic replay)
 run: |
 set -euo pipefail
 python -m pip install pytest==8.3.5 pandas==2.2.3 numpy==2.2.4
 python -m pytest -q backend/research/architecture_factory/test_a1_manual_research_budget_v1.py tests/test_a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1.py tests/test_issue1414_preauto_contract_v1.py
 - name: Verify blocker-only ROI policy
 run: |
 set -euo pipefail
 python - <<'PY'
 import json
 from pathlib import Path
 wf=Path('.github/workflows/a1-youtube-diversity-scout-v1.yml').read_text()
 policy=json.load(open('backend/research/architecture_factory/a1_gemini_youtube_roi_policy_v1.json'))
 assert '\n schedule:' not in wf
 assert 'blocker:' in wf and 'required: true' in wf
 assert policy['automatic_collection_enabled'] is False
 assert policy['scheduled_collection_enabled'] is False
 assert policy['manual_dispatch_enabled'] is True
 assert policy['manual_blocker_required'] is True
 assert int(policy['manual_run_budget']['max_video_reviews']) <= 3
 assert int(policy['manual_run_budget']['max_candidate_pool']) <= 30
 assert policy['selection_authority'] is False and policy['promotion_authority'] is False
 assert policy['execution_authority']=='NONE' and policy['order_authority']=='BLOCKED' and policy['live_trade_authority']=='BLOCKED'
 assert int(policy['protected_top5_mutations']) == 0
 print('PASS_GEMINI_YOUTUBE_BLOCKER_ONLY_ROI_POLICY')
 PY

 scout:
 if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
 runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 timeout-minutes: 40
 steps:
 - uses: actions/checkout@v4
 with:
 ref: ${{ github.ref }}
 fetch-depth: 0
 - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
 with:
 python-version: '3.12'
 - name: Enforce named blocker and ROI cooldown policy
 env:
 BLOCKER_CONTEXT: ${{ inputs.blocker }}
 run: |
 set -euo pipefail
 python - <<'PY'
 import json, os
 blocker=(os.environ.get('BLOCKER_CONTEXT') or '').strip()
 policy=json.load(open('backend/research/architecture_factory/a1_gemini_youtube_roi_policy_v1.json'))
 econ=json.load(open('backend/research/architecture_factory/a1_a5_economic_improvement_latest.json'))
 assert blocker, 'NAMED_STRATEGY_BLOCKER_REQUIRED'
 from backend.research.architecture_factory.a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1 import validate_context
 from pathlib import Path
 context=validate_context(json.loads(blocker))
 Path("out").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 Path("out/blocker_context.json").write_text(json.dumps(context))
 assert policy['automatic_collection_enabled'] is False
 assert policy['manual_dispatch_enabled'] is True
 assert policy['manual_blocker_required'] is True
 passes=int(econ.get('development_economic_pass_count') or 0)
 print(json.dumps({
 'state': policy['state'],
 'blocker': blocker,
 'development_economic_pass_count': passes,
 'mode': 'MANUAL_BLOCKER_ONLY',
 'automatic_collection': False,
 }, sort_keys=True))
 PY
 - name: Review at most three blocker-relevant videos with Gemini
 env:
 GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY || secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
 A1_YOUTUBE_GEMINI_MODELS: 'models/gemini-3.6-flash'
 YOUTUBE_DIVERSITY_SEARCH_GROUP_SIZE: '3'
 YOUTUBE_DIVERSITY_MAX_VIDEO_REVIEWS: '3'
 YOUTUBE_DIVERSITY_MAX_POOL: '30'
 EXISTING_RECEIPT: ${{ inputs.existing_receipt }}
 run: |
 set -euo pipefail
 mkdir -p out
 python -m backend.research.architecture_factory.a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1 \
 --context out/blocker_context.json \
 --existing "$EXISTING_RECEIPT" \
 --registry backend/research/zel_manual_video_registry_v1.json \
 --output out/a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1.json
 python - <<'PY'
 import json
 r=json.load(open('out/a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1.json'))
 assert r['research_only'] is True
 assert r['selection_authority'] is False and r['promotion_authority'] is False
 assert r['execution_authority']=='NONE' and r['order_authority']=='BLOCKED' and r['live_trade_authority']=='BLOCKED'
 assert int(r['protected_mutations'])==0 and r['factory_blocking'] is False
 assert 1<=len(r['buckets'])<=3
 assert r['request_audit']['generation_requests']<=4
 assert int(r['metrics']['candidate_pool_count']) <= 30
 assert int(r['metrics'].get('reviewed_now') or 0) <= 3
 assert all(x['accepted_for_hypothesis_only'] is True and x['direct_video_analysis'] is True for x in r.get('accepted_sources') or [])
 assert all(x['evidence_authority']=='HYPOTHESIS_ONLY_REQUIRES_LOCAL_REPLAY' for x in r.get('factory_sources') or [])
 print(json.dumps({'state':r['state'],**r['metrics']},sort_keys=True))
 PY
 - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
 if: always()
 with:
 name: a1-youtube-diversity-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
 path: out/a1_youtube_diversity_scout_v1.json
 if-no-files-found: warn
 retention-days: 60
'
